nodes.label: middlewares/logger.middleware.ts

nodes.label: middlewares/error.middleware.ts

nodes.label: auth.controller.ts

nodes.label: 001-user-login/quickstart.md
nodes.description: Step-by-step implementation guide for the user-login feature: prerequisites, dependency install, implementation order (entities → service → controller → routes → rate-limiting → tests), key code patterns for token issuance and brute-force.

nodes.label: 001-user-login/tasks.md
nodes.description: Task breakdown for user-login feature across 7 phases (Setup, Foundational, US1-US4, Polish). All 28 tasks marked [x] complete. Includes parallel-execution hints and dependency graph.

nodes.label: 001-user-login/research.md
nodes.description: Architecture decision records for user-login: Google OAuth ID-token approach, SHA-256 refresh token storage, Redis TTL brute-force, refresh token rotation + theft detection, is_active vs Redis lockout separation, HS256 JWT with opaque refresh tokens.
nodes.rationale: ID-token approach chosen over server-side code exchange (no redirect endpoint needed, fits React SPA pattern). SHA-256 chosen over bcrypt for refresh tokens (speed) and over raw storage (DB compromise protection). Redis TTL chosen over DB columns for brute-force (zero cron overhead, auto-expires). Refresh token rotation + theft detection follows RFC 6819.

nodes.label: 001-user-login/data-model.md
nodes.description: Data model spec for user-login: User entity (users table) and RefreshToken entity (refresh_tokens table) column definitions, Redis key patterns for brute-force, PostgreSQL enum values (user_role, auth_provider), and entity relationships.

nodes.label: 001-user-login/plan.md
nodes.description: Implementation plan for user-login: technical context (TypeScript 5.x, Node.js 22+, Jest+Supertest against rcfeild_test), constitution check (RBAC enforcement required for logout), project structure mapping spec docs to source files.

nodes.label: 001-user-login/spec.md

nodes.label: 001-user-login/checklists/requirements.md
nodes.description: Spec quality checklist for user-login. All items pass: no implementation details in spec, requirements testable, success criteria measurable, edge cases identified, no NEEDS_CLARIFICATION markers. Spec cleared for /speckit-plan.

nodes.description: API contract definitions for /api/v1/auth: POST /login, /google, /refresh, /logout. Specifies request schemas, response shapes (success and all error codes), and per-endpoint business rules (Redis counter logic, SHA-256 hashing, revocation on logout).

nodes.label: User Entity
nodes.description: TypeORM entity mapping to the users table. Columns: id (UUID PK), email (unique), password_hash (nullable), role (user_role enum), auth_provider (auth_provider enum), google_id (nullable), is_active, trust_score, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at (soft delete).

nodes.label: RefreshToken Entity
nodes.description: TypeORM entity mapping to the refresh_tokens table. Columns: id (UUID PK), user_id (FK → users), token (SHA-256 hash of raw token), expires_at, created_at, revoked_at (nullable). Valid when revoked_at IS NULL AND expires_at > now().

nodes.label: Redis auth:failed key
nodes.description: Redis key pattern auth:failed:{email} with 900s TTL. Stores integer count of consecutive failed logins per account. Count >= 5 triggers ACCOUNT_LOCKED (403). Auto-expires — no admin intervention needed.

nodes.label: INVALID_CREDENTIALS error code
nodes.description: HTTP 401 error returned for both wrong password and non-existent email. Intentionally identical message to avoid account enumeration (FR-006).

nodes.label: ACCOUNT_LOCKED error code
nodes.description: HTTP 403 error returned for both is_active=false (permanent admin lockout) and Redis counter >= 5 (temporary brute-force lockout). Same response shape prevents revealing reason for lockout.

nodes.label: GOOGLE_AUTH_FAILED error code
nodes.description: HTTP 401 error returned when google-auth-library OAuth2Client.verifyIdToken() throws or returns no email payload.

nodes.label: INVALID_REFRESH_TOKEN error code
nodes.description: HTTP 401 error for refresh token not found, expired, or already revoked. Reusing a revoked token also triggers full session wipe for the user (theft detection).

nodes.label: authenticate middleware
nodes.description: JWT validation middleware imported from middlewares/auth.middleware.ts. Applied only to POST /logout in the auth router. Populates req.user with userId, email, and role.

nodes.label: authLimiter (express-rate-limit)
nodes.description: Per-IP rate limiter applied to all /auth routes: 100 requests per 15 minutes (windowMs: 900000). Returns 429 TOO_MANY_REQUESTS on breach.

nodes.label: UserRole enum
nodes.description: Enum with values CUSTOMER, PROVIDER, STAFF, ADMIN. Used in JWT payload, User entity, and RBAC guards.

nodes.label: AuthProvider enum
nodes.description: Enum with values LOCAL, GOOGLE. Stored in users.auth_provider column. Determines login method available to the account.

nodes.label: AppError class
nodes.description: Custom error class thrown throughout services. Constructor: (message, statusCode, code). Caught by global error middleware and serialised to JSON error responses.

nodes.label: Zod validation schemas
nodes.description: Centralised Zod schemas: LoginSchema (email + min-8 password), GoogleSchema (id_token), RefreshSchema (refresh_token), LogoutSchema (refresh_token). Imported by controllers — never defined inline.

nodes.label: AppDataSource
nodes.description: TypeORM DataSource for PostgreSQL. Entities array includes User and RefreshToken. Used by repositories in auth.service.ts and directly by test helpers.

nodes.label: redis (ioredis client)
nodes.description: ioredis client exported as redis. Used in auth.service.ts for brute-force counters (INCR, EXPIRE, DEL, GET) and in auth.test.ts to clear keys between tests.

nodes.label: OAuth2Client (google-auth-library)
nodes.description: google-auth-library OAuth2Client used for server-side ID token verification. Instantiated per-request in loginWithGoogle() with GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID as audience.

nodes.label: Feature 001: User Login
nodes.description: Complete authentication feature: email/password login, Google OAuth, token refresh with rotation, logout. Status: all 28 tasks complete. Target: rcfeild-be backend.

nodes.label: ADR-001: B2B SaaS Chain Branch Model
nodes.description: Architecture decision: RCField is B2B SaaS sold to one business operating a chain of RC branches. Chose Model D (chain model like Starbucks) over marketplace, per-tenant subdomain, or hybrid. All branches share one app and one domain. rationale: only 1 enterprise customer; mentor confirmed multi-branch management; discovery still available; per-branch config needed.

nodes.label: ADR-002: Express.js Backend Framework
nodes.description: Architecture decision: use Express.js over NestJS for the backend. rationale: no learning curve for the 4-person team, 4-month timeline safety, sufficient for project scope. Mitigations: requireRole middleware for RBAC, zod for validation, global AppError middleware, node-cron for jobs, convention-enforced routing structure.

nodes.label: Sequence Flow: Booking Lifecycle
nodes.description: End-to-end sequence diagram from booking creation to completion or cancellation. Covers: create booking, payment, check-in (booking->session), extension, check-out with incident policy, and completion/settlement. Uses sessions for actual play and incidents for damage/incident logging.

nodes.label: Spec 00: Project Overview
nodes.description: RCField B2B SaaS platform for RC car field operations. Phase 1 Operational Core includes 41 tables: booking/session lifecycle, fleet, BYOC, F&B, packages, subscriptions, contests, promotions, inspections, disputes, maintenance logs, trust score, feature flags. Phase 2 adds AI, SaaS tenant/billing, advanced multi-party dispute workflow.

nodes.label: Spec 01: Domain Model
nodes.description: Defines all Phase 1 entities (User, Cafe, Vehicle, CustomerVehicle, Booking, BookingParticipant, BookingVehicle, Session, SessionParticipant, SessionVehicle, PaymentComponent, PaymentTransaction, Inspection, InspectionPhoto, InspectionChecklist, ExtensionProposal, FnbOrder, Package, Subscription, Contest, Incident, Dispute, Promotion, Review, NotificationLog, TrustScoreLog, FeatureFlag) and all enums.

nodes.label: Spec 02: Booking & Session State Machine
nodes.description: Defines two independent state machines: Booking (PENDING->CONFIRMED->COMPLETED/CANCELLED/NO_SHOW) and Session (CHECKED_IN->ACTIVE->EXTENDING->CHECKING_OUT->COMPLETED/CANCELLED). All transitions must go through service layer. Includes timeout rules and event enums.

nodes.label: Spec 03: Payment Engine
nodes.description: Critical spec for all payment logic. Principles: snapshot-first, component isolation, immutable ledger, platform fee only on consummated components, DB row lock for race conditions, settlement per session. Defines component lifecycle, refund rules R1/R2/R3, extension fee cap, damage charge formula, discount/platform fee calculation.

nodes.label: Spec 04: Inspection Flow
nodes.description: Digital evidence mechanism at every asset handover. Check-in flow: create session, 4 mandatory photos (FRONT/BACK/LEFT/RIGHT), checklist, pre_existing_flag, customer confirmation with 15-min auto-confirm timeout. Check-out flow: re-photograph same angles, compare, flag damage, customer confirmation with 2h/24h timeouts. Photo storage via Cloudinary.

nodes.label: Spec 05: API Contracts
nodes.description: REST API surface for Phase 1. Endpoints for Auth, Cafes, Fleet, Bookings, Sessions, Inspections, Extensions, Incidents, F&B, Packages, Subscriptions, Contests. Standard response format {data, meta?, error?}. Common error codes defined.

nodes.label: Spec 06: Database Specification
nodes.description: Schema source of truth for Phase 1 Operational Core (41 tables). Conventions: snake_case plural table names, UUID PKs, numeric(15,2) for money, jsonb for snapshots, timestamptz UTC, soft delete via deleted_at.

nodes.label: BR-Payment: Payment Business Rules
nodes.description: Business rules for payment. BR-PM-001 snapshot-first, BR-PM-002 immutable ledger, BR-PM-003 component isolation. Component creation on CONFIRMED, extension, damage. Settlement per session. Refund rules R1 (customer cancel), R2 (provider cancel), R3 (no-show). Damage charge formula. F&B payment rules.

nodes.label: BR-FnB: F&B Business Rules
nodes.description: F&B pre-order gated to booking time, merged into single payment transaction. On-site order linked to Session, paid directly to Provider (cash/bank transfer). Platform takes 0% on all F&B. Menu per branch; items can be toggled without deletion.

nodes.label: BR-Promotions: Promotion Business Rules
nodes.description: Promotion validation: 8-step fail-fast check. Discount calculation: PERCENT (capped by max_discount_amount) or FIXED (capped at subtotal). Security deposit never discounted. Usage locked atomically at booking PENDING. Rollback on cancel via cron. 1 promo per booking. Platform fee calculated on discounted amount. Promo details snapshotted in booking.snapshot.

nodes.label: BR-Extension: Slot Extension Business Rules
nodes.description: Extension only when session ACTIVE. Staff proposes, customer decides. Extension fee cap = 50% of security_deposit. Multiple extensions allowed within cap. Fee is post-paid (HELD component, settled from deposit). Session planned_end_at updated on approval. 10-minute customer response timeout -> auto-reject.

nodes.label: BR-Fleet: Fleet Management Business Rules
nodes.description: Three vehicle tiers: STANDARD (1.0x damage multiplier), PREMIUM (1.5x), RESTRICTED (2.0x). Vehicle only rentable when AVAILABLE. Status transitions: AVAILABLE->IN_USE on check-in, IN_USE->AVAILABLE on session complete/cancel. BYOC vehicles not restricted by track compatibility. Fleet is per-branch; no cross-branch sharing.

nodes.label: BR-Dispute: Incident & Dispute Business Rules
nodes.description: Phase 1 has two layers: Incident (policy-based, Staff/Admin) and Dispute (formal, Admin-only). Incidents require session evidence from inspections. Incomplete inspection evidence = no damage charge. Responsible party: CUSTOMER/PROVIDER/STAFF/SHARED/UNKNOWN. Disputes: max 1 per booking, only before COMPLETED, Admin-only adjudication. Multi-party arbitration is Phase 2.

nodes.label: BR-Booking: Booking Business Rules
nodes.description: Fixed slot system per cafe.slot_duration_minutes. Multi-slot and multi-vehicle bookings. Availability checks for RENTAL and BYOC. Redis slot lock (TTL 1800s) before DB insert. 30-minute payment window. Cancellation refund tiers (>24h, 12-24h, <12h). No-show auto-cancel after 30 min post slot_start. Vehicle eligibility by tier and trust_score.

nodes.label: BR-Inspection: Inspection Business Rules
nodes.description: Inspection is digital evidence at every asset handover. 4 mandatory photos (FRONT/BACK/LEFT/RIGHT). Full checklist required. pre_existing_flag valid only with complete inspection + customer confirmation. Check-in: 1 per session, staff must be assigned to branch. RENTAL and BYOC have different checklist formats. Check-out: 2h no-damage timeout, 24h damage auto-confirm. Photo retention: 90 days after COMPLETED, 30 days post incident/dispute resolution.

nodes.label: Business Rules README
nodes.description: Index of all business rule files. Links each domain file to corresponding technical spec. Format: BR-[DOMAIN]-[NNN] with IF/THEN/NOTE structure.

nodes.label: Cafe Entity
nodes.description: Branch/location entity. Has per-branch config: operating_hours JSON, track_types, slot_duration_minutes, slot_fee_rate, max_concurrent_bookings, byoc_capacity.

nodes.label: Vehicle Entity
nodes.description: Rental vehicle in fleet. Has tier (STANDARD/PREMIUM/RESTRICTED), status (AVAILABLE/IN_USE/MAINTENANCE/RETIRED), hourly_rate, security_deposit, damage_multiplier, compatible_track_types.

nodes.label: Booking Entity
nodes.description: Planned reservation record. No direct vehicle_id. Has snapshot JSON for price/policy immutability. Linked to booking_vehicles for rental vehicles. Has booking_mode (SINGLE/PACKAGE/SUBSCRIPTION) and play_mode (RENTAL/BYOC/MIXED).

nodes.label: Session Entity
nodes.description: Actual play session created at check-in. A booking can have 0..N sessions. Tracks actual_start_at, planned_end_at, actual_total_amount. Linked to session_participants, session_vehicles, inspections, extension_proposals, incidents.

nodes.label: PaymentComponent Entity
nodes.description: Immutable payment ledger entry. Types: SLOT_FEE/RENTAL_FEE/SECURITY_DEPOSIT/EXTENSION_FEE/DAMAGE_CHARGE/FNB_PREORDER/FNB_ON_SITE/PACKAGE_PURCHASE/CONTEST_ENTRY. Status: PENDING/HELD/DISBURSED/REFUNDED/PARTIALLY_REFUNDED/CAPTURED. Amount never updated; create new component for adjustments.

nodes.label: Inspection Entity
nodes.description: Digital evidence record at asset handover. Linked to session and optionally session_vehicle. Has type (CHECK_IN/CHECK_OUT/STAFF_HANDOVER), pre_existing_flag, damage_noted, customer_confirmed status.

nodes.label: Incident Entity
nodes.description: Operational incident log within a session. Has status (RECORDED/REVIEWED/RESOLVED/WAIVED), responsible_party, final_amount, resolution_note. Complete when all fields are set.

nodes.label: Dispute Entity
nodes.description: Formal dispute record. Max 1 per booking. Only Admin can resolve. Uses inspection evidence as baseline. Cannot open after booking COMPLETED.

nodes.label: Payment Component Lifecycle
nodes.description: Components created at CONFIRMED (SLOT_FEE, RENTAL_FEE, SECURITY_DEPOSIT, FNB_PREORDER). Extension creates EXTENSION_FEE per session. Damage creates DAMAGE_CHARGE. Settlement at session COMPLETED: disburse to Provider, refund deposit to Customer. Platform fee 15% on disbursed amounts.

nodes.label: Evidence-Based Inspection Principle
nodes.description: No valid inspection = no basis for DAMAGE_CHARGE or incident resolution. 4 photos required (FRONT/BACK/LEFT/RIGHT). pre_existing_flag only valid with complete inspection + customer confirmation. Provider loses damage rights if inspection protocol is incomplete.

nodes.label: Booking-Session Data Separation
nodes.description: Planned data (booking, booking_participants, booking_vehicles) is separate from actual data (session, session_participants, session_vehicles). No vehicle_id directly on bookings. BYOC vehicles only finalized at check-in via session_vehicles.

nodes.label: Cloudinary Photo Storage
nodes.description: Inspection photos uploaded to Cloudinary. URL stored in inspection_photos table. Folder convention: inspections/{session_id}/{session_vehicle_id}/{check_in|check_out}/{angle}. Retention: 90 days post COMPLETED, extended during incidents/disputes.

nodes.label: Redis Slot Lock Mechanism
nodes.description: SET NX for RENTAL slots, INCR counter for BYOC, TTL 1800s. Slot locked in Redis before DB insert to prevent race conditions. Redis TTL releases availability; cron job handles booking status=CANCELLED and promo rollback.

nodes.label: Platform Fee Model
nodes.description: 15% platform fee on disbursed amounts to Provider (SLOT_FEE + RENTAL_FEE + EXTENSION_FEE + DAMAGE_CHARGE after discount). 0% on SECURITY_DEPOSIT (customer's money). 0% on all F&B. Fee calculated on consummated, post-discount amounts.

nodes.label: Vehicle Tier System
nodes.description: STANDARD (deposit low, 1.0x multiplier, all customers), PREMIUM (medium deposit, 1.5x, eligible customers), RESTRICTED (high deposit, 2.0x, limited/approval required). Eligibility tied to trust_score (details TBD).

nodes.label: B2B SaaS Chain Model
nodes.description: Single enterprise customer (Provider) with multiple branches sharing one platform. Not marketplace, not per-tenant subdomain. All branches discoverable via shared app. Per-branch config for pricing, fleet, F&B menu. PROVIDER sees aggregate chain reports + per-branch drill-down.

nodes.label: Express.js Architecture
nodes.description: routes/ -> controllers/ -> services/ -> models/ layered architecture enforced by code review convention. RBAC via requireRole middleware. Validation via zod. Error handling via global AppError middleware. Jobs via node-cron. Storage via Cloudinary.

nodes.label: ERD Core Preview
nodes.description: Entity-relationship diagram showing core entities. Visible relationships include: User (blue) owns Cafe (green, center), User 1:N makes Booking (green, center), User 1:N at Cafe, Cafe 0:1:N Booking, Booking 1:N to payment/inspection related table (orange, right with FK/confirm columns), Booking 1:N to session_vehicles or similar (blue, bottom-left), Booking 1:N to another table (yellow, bottom-center), Booking 1:0..1 to dispute (pink, bottom-right). Text is small and partially unreadable in image.

nodes.label: RCField Platform
nodes.description: B2B SaaS for RC car track chain operator in Vietnam. One provider, multiple branches, shared system. Not a marketplace. Core value: structured digital evidence at every asset handover to eliminate damage disputes.

nodes.label: Actor: Customer
nodes.description: Customer role: books slots, pre-orders F&B, makes payments, confirms check-in/out, opens disputes. Uses mobile-first web app. Has trust_score (0-100, default 100) affecting RESTRICTED tier rental eligibility.

nodes.label: Actor: Staff
nodes.description: Staff role: performs check-in/out, records F&B orders, proposes extensions, uploads inspection photos. Uses mobile-first web app. Assigned to one cafe per staff_cafe_assignments.

nodes.label: Actor: Provider
nodes.description: Provider role: manages all branches (cafes), fleet, F&B menus, views revenue. Uses desktop/tablet web app. Sees aggregate totals plus drill-down per branch.

nodes.label: Actor: Admin
nodes.description: Admin role: team RCField (the software vendor). Approves cafes, monitors incident policy, manages feature flags, adjudicates formal disputes. Uses desktop admin portal.

nodes.label: Web App (Frontend)
nodes.description: ReactJS + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS SPA. Mobile-first. Role-based UI routing from JWT UserRole. All 4 actors share one app. Server state via React Query, client state via Zustand, HTTP via Axios. Vietnamese UI.

nodes.label: API Server (Backend)
nodes.description: Node.js 20+/22 + Express.js REST API. TypeScript strict mode. Router-per-domain architecture: auth, bookings, sessions, inspections, incidents, payments, fleet, F&B. Middleware stack: logger → CORS → JWT → RBAC. Validation via Zod. Business logic in service layer.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL Database
nodes.description: PostgreSQL 16 accessed via TypeORM. 26 operational tables (Phase 1). All monetary values NUMERIC(15,2). UUID PKs. Soft delete on users, vehicles, menu_items. bookings.snapshot (jsonb) is the sole source for payment calculations.

nodes.label: Redis Cache / Lock
nodes.description: Redis 7 used for slot locking. Redis key pattern: slot:rental:{cafeId}:{vehicleId}:{date}:{slotStart} (SET NX, TTL 1800s). Also used for session/job queue.

nodes.label: Payment Gateway (TBD)
nodes.description: External payment processor, provider not yet finalized (VNPay / MoMo / VietQR). Handles booking + F&B pre-order payment in one transaction. Server-side signature verification required. Interface abstracted for easy swap.

nodes.label: Scheduler / Cron Jobs
nodes.description: Node.js cron jobs enforcing timeout rules: PENDING booking 30m auto-cancel, no-show 30m after slot_start, check-in auto-confirm 15m, extension auto-reject 10m, checkout auto-confirm 2h (no damage) or 24h (damage).

nodes.label: Module: Auth
nodes.description: Auth domain module at /auth. JWT access token (15m) + refresh token (7d). RBAC with 4 roles. Endpoints: register, login, refresh, me. All enums in src/types/index.ts, all Zod schemas in src/validate/index.ts.

nodes.label: Module: Booking
nodes.description: Booking domain module at /bookings. Manages booking lifecycle and state machine. State transitions must go through BookingService.transition(). Supports RENTAL, BYOC, MIXED modes.

nodes.label: Module: Payment
nodes.description: Internal payment service (no direct router). Component-based immutable ledger. Types: SLOT_FEE, RENTAL_FEE, SECURITY_DEPOSIT, EXTENSION_FEE, DAMAGE_CHARGE, FB_PREORDER. Platform fee 15% on consummated components disbursed to Provider (0% on F&B). Settlement per session.

nodes.label: Module: Fleet
nodes.description: Fleet domain module at /cafes/:id/vehicles. Vehicle CRUD, tier (STANDARD/PREMIUM/RESTRICTED), status management. Vehicle has hourly_rate, security_deposit, damage_multiplier, compatible_track_types.

nodes.label: Module: Inspection
nodes.description: Inspection domain module at /bookings/:id/inspections. Check-in/out protocol with 4-angle photo upload to Cloudinary + checklist. Evidence chain: inspections → inspection_photos → inspection_checklists. Missing photos/checklist = Provider loses right to charge DAMAGE_CHARGE.

nodes.label: Module: Extension
nodes.description: Extension domain module at /sessions/:id/extensions. Staff proposes extra time, Customer approves/rejects. 10-minute auto-reject timeout. Fee is post-paid, charged against deposit (max 50%).

nodes.label: Module: Incident
nodes.description: Incident domain module at /incidents. Policy-based automated resolution: log responsible_party, final_amount, resolution_note. Phase 1 layer for damage/dispute handling before formal dispute escalation.

nodes.label: Module: F&B
nodes.description: F&B domain module at /cafes/:id/menu and /bookings/:id/fnb-orders. Menu management, pre-order (bundled with booking payment), on-site order (customer pays Provider directly, platform not involved). 0% platform fee on F&B.

nodes.label: Module: Cafe
nodes.description: Cafe discovery module at /cafes. Listing, filtering, branch profile, shareable links (Zalo/FB). Config: track_types, slot_duration_minutes, slot_fee_rate, byoc_capacity. Status: PENDING/ACTIVE/SUSPENDED.

nodes.label: Entity: PaymentTransaction
nodes.description: Raw payment gateway log. Columns: booking_id→bookings, gateway, gateway_transaction_id, type (PAYMENT/REFUND), raw_request (jsonb), raw_response (jsonb). Separate from component ledger.

nodes.label: Entity: InspectionRecord
nodes.description: Check-in or check-out inspection per booking. Columns: booking_id→bookings, type (CHECK_IN/CHECK_OUT), performed_by→users, photos (jsonb), checklist (jsonb), pre_existing_flag, damage_noted. UNIQUE(booking_id, type).

nodes.label: Entity: ExtensionProposal
nodes.description: Session extension request. Columns: booking_id→bookings, proposed_by→users, duration_minutes, fee_amount, status (PENDING/APPROVED/REJECTED/EXPIRED). 10-minute auto-reject timeout.

nodes.label: Entity: Promotion
nodes.description: Discount code. Columns: code (UNIQUE when active), discount_type (PERCENT/FIXED), discount_value, max_discount_amount, applicable_to (ALL/RENTAL/BYOC), cafe_id→cafes (NULL=global chain-wide), uses_count, max_uses, max_uses_per_user.

nodes.label: Entity: TrustScoreLog
nodes.description: Immutable customer trust score history. Columns: user_id→users, booking_id→bookings (nullable), delta, score_before, score_after, reason (NO_SHOW/DAMAGE_CONFIRMED/DISPUTE_LOST/BOOKING_STREAK/ADMIN_ADJUSTMENT). Trust score (0-100) affects RESTRICTED tier rental eligibility.

nodes.label: Entity: FnbOrder
nodes.description: F&B order. Types: PRE_ORDER (bundled with booking payment, 0% platform fee) or ON_SITE (customer pays Provider directly, outside platform). Columns: booking_id→bookings, type (PRE_ORDER/ON_SITE), status (PENDING/CONFIRMED/DELIVERED/CANCELLED), created_by→users.

nodes.label: Entity: FeatureFlag
nodes.description: Feature toggle system. Columns: feature_key (UNIQUE), is_enabled, is_trial, trial_ends_at. Managed by ADMIN role.

nodes.label: Booking State Machine
nodes.description: States: PENDING→CONFIRMED (payment success), PENDING→CANCELLED (30m timeout or customer cancel), CONFIRMED→COMPLETED (all sessions done), CONFIRMED→CANCELLED, CONFIRMED→NO_SHOW (slot_start + 30m no check-in). All transitions via BookingService.transition(bookingId, event).

nodes.label: Session State Machine
nodes.description: States: CHECKED_IN→ACTIVE (check-in complete), CHECKED_IN→CANCELLED; ACTIVE→EXTENDING (extension proposed), ACTIVE→CHECKING_OUT; EXTENDING→ACTIVE (approved/rejected/10m timeout); CHECKING_OUT→COMPLETED (customer confirm or auto-confirm 2h/24h). All transitions via SessionService.transition().

nodes.label: Snapshot-First Payment Principle
nodes.description: All payment calculations read from booking.snapshot (jsonb), never from current cafe/vehicle prices. Prices are locked at booking creation time.
nodes.rationale: Vehicle and slot prices can change over time; snapshot ensures correct billing regardless of price changes after booking.

nodes.label: Planned vs Actual Separation
nodes.description: Booking = planned contract (booking_participants, booking_vehicles, slot_start/slot_end). Session = actual operations (session_participants, session_vehicles, actual_start_at/actual_end_at). Session created only when Staff checks in, not at booking time.
nodes.rationale: Separating planned from actual data allows flexible operations (vehicle swaps, participant changes) without corrupting the original booking contract.

nodes.label: Evidence-Based Handover
nodes.description: Digital evidence created at every asset handover: 4-angle photos (front/back/left/right) + checklist at check-in and check-out. Evidence chain: inspections → inspection_photos → inspection_checklists. Missing evidence = Provider forfeits DAMAGE_CHARGE right.
nodes.rationale: Core value proposition: structured evidence eliminates damage disputes by providing objective photographic proof.

nodes.label: Backend Logger (src/config/logger.ts)
nodes.description: Custom logger used throughout backend. Methods: logger.auth(), logger.info(), logger.warn(), logger.error(), logger.debug(). console.log is forbidden.

nodes.label: Backend Zod Schemas (src/validate/index.ts)
nodes.description: Centralized Zod validation schemas grouped by table. Controllers import from '../validate'. Schemas never defined inside controllers.

nodes.label: Backend Enums & Types (src/types/index.ts)
nodes.description: Centralized TypeScript enums (BookingStatus, AssetTier, etc.), AppError class, AuthRequest interface. Enums never defined inside entities or services.
